findings.summary: assets-state's messageOf still reads e.message raw (not errorTextOf), and the setImportSettings/writeTextAsset catch blocks (lines 346, 475) only set the inline error, never onError/reportError.
findings.scenario: Latent: a host that sends ErrorCoded 'forbidden' (the future per-user role) for an import-settings apply or a text-file save. The asset detail or tab would show 'forbidden' glued to the host's message (the U+2063 marks are invisible but the code letters are not), and no banner would appear. A readOnly denial cannot reach these paths today, because blockedReason uses the store's write guard.

notes: All 4 prior findings fixed. (1) medium: ipcError now prefixes the message with U+2063 code U+2063; errorCodeOf/errorTextOf parse it from the message alone, so it survives the contextBridge (test now models a message-only bridge); main ipc.ts sends only the code and the message (no token); non-coded and 1.10 errors pass through unchanged (no prefix, code undefined); store.reportError, store.run and inspector messageOf strip the prefix. (2) inspector denials with a code now also go to onError, reported to the banner; ordinary failures stay inline; tests added. (3) the asset menu's Open Scene is disabled when hostReadOnly is set, the double-click returns early; DOM tests added. (4) README fixed. CI 3/3 green.
